title.value: How Do Open Source Software Contributors Perceive and Address Usability? Valued Factors, Practices, and Challenges
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the paper, directly describing the focus of the study on usability in open source software contributions.
title.quote: How Do Open Source Software Contributors Perceive and Address Usability? Valued Factors, Practices, and Challenges

extractions.description: The paper investigates how contributors to open source software perceive and address usability issues. Through a survey of 84 contributors, it highlights their practices, challenges, and factors they consider important in usability, emphasizing a system-centric approach rather than a user-centric one. The study aims to provide insights and suggestions to improve usability practices in open source software communities.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The core theme of the paper is usability in open source software, which does not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Usability is an increasing concern in open source software (OSS).

applications.quote: Our work provided important insights for OSS practitioners and tool designers in exploring ways for promoting a user-centric mindset and improving usability practice in the current OSS communities.
